style: Avant-garde funk theater and microtonal chamber ensemble, pélog-informed non-equidistant pitch collection with microtonal pure interval friction, angular talking-drum lines and zampoña panpipe hockets, cellular-automaton rhythm competing with entrainment clocks, dry pizzicato upright bass, bowed cello, grainy viola, screeching violin, agogô bells, talking drum, carnival barker lead narration with distorted echo group, frantic theatrical camp delivery with motion-driven accelerando, pirate radio transmission artifacts, pattern-sequencer workflow, thermal throttling, operational resonance distortion harmonics, dynamic kinetic frequency shifts, systemic acoustic feedback loops, spatial algorithmic reverberation decay tails, structural metallic timbre modulation transients, frequency-domain modulation matrices, unpredictable rhythmic synchronization fluctuations, high-density experimental processing modules, micro-interval pitch variance oscillators, non-linear harmonic distortion.
lyrics:
[SECTION: OPENING RECRUITMENT]
[TEMPORAL ENGINE: FORWARD REFERENCE]
[TRANSMISSION: PIRATE RADIO ON 88.4 MHz]
[CARNIVAL BARKER LEAD][VOICE TOPOLOGY: LEADER + DISTORTED ECHO GROUP]
Step right up! Step right up to the administrative counter of the lower void!
[DISTORTED ECHO GROUP]: (Lower void! Void! Void!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Do you suffer from unresolved causal debt and semantic instability?
[ECHO GROUP]: (Semantic instability! Stability!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Look at the sensor dials! The contradiction meter is spinning red!
[PHYSICAL GESTURE: MOTION-DRIVEN ACCELERANDO - FOOTSTOMPS ACCELERATING]
[BAND ENTERS: UPRIGHT BASS PLUCK, AGOGÔ BELLS ANCHOR]
[SECTION: ONTOLOGY COLLISION]
[MUTATOR: IDENTITY ACCIDENT - A IS B]
The administrative filing cabinet is literally a hungry mountain goat!
[VIOLA SCRATCH TONE, CELLO BOW NOISE]
[TALKING DRUM PITCH BEND]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Feed the mountain goat your unprocessed tax forms! Every receipt chewed is a sin forgiven!
[ECHO GROUP]: (Chewed receipts! Forgiven! Forgiven!)
[SECTION: OMISSION CARTOGRAPHY]
[NEGATIVE SEMANTIC TRIANGULATION: BLOCKING DIRECT MENTION]
[ZAMPOÑA ANDEAN PANPIPES HOCKET: ALTERNATING TUBE GROUPS]
[VIOLIN TREMOLO, CELLO BASS OSTINATO]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: We do not speak the forbidden noun! We only observe the falling barometer!
[ECHO GROUP]: (Barometer falling! Falling!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: We map the missing perimeter by the frost on the windowpane and the shrieking of the agogô bells!
[AGOGÔ BELLS TIMELINE: UNEQUAL INTERVAL CLAVE]
[SECTION: UTILITY DEMON AND PROCEDURE TABOO]
[UTILITY FUNCTION: REWARDING STRUCTURAL CONTRADICTION]
[DETOUR DEVIL: FORBIDDING THE DIRECT PATH]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: To reach the exit, you must take the detour through the bureaucratic laundry chute!
[ECHO GROUP]: (Laundry chute! Chute! Chute!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Do not walk! Roll sideways while reciting municipal bylaws backward!
[SECTION: SYSTEMIC CONTAGION AND TAXONOMIC INVASION]
[PARASITE INTERN: IMPORTING FOREIGN INSECT LIFECYCLE]
[DOUBLE BASS BOWED TECTONIC DRONE]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: The repair logic has expired! The pupae are hatching in the ledger columns!
[ECHO GROUP]: (Hatching in the ledgers! Ledgers!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Larvae consume the deficit! The deficit pupates into a singing chorus of angry auditors!
[SECTION: MULTI-AXIAL SHEAR AND SUBSTRATE SMUGGLING]
[MINORITY MUTANT: SELECTING ANOMALOUS READING]
[ZAMPOÑA HOCKET ACCELERATES WITH MOTION]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Is it a musical scale or a geological fault line?
[ECHO GROUP]: (Fault line! Fault!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: The chord structure is sliding down the tectonic plate into the magma chamber!
[SECTION: AXIOM VANDALISM AND RETCON RAT]
[AXIOM VANDAL: NEGATING LOAD-BEARING ASSUMPTION]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Gravity is hereby repealed! Upward falling is mandatory for all ticket holders!
[ECHO GROUP]: (Mandatory falling upward! Upward!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: And remember: what you heard in the opening stanza was actually a prophecy of the kitchen fire!
[SECTION: INVENTED EMOTION AND JPEG BRAIN]
[EMOTION CRYPTID: KESTRAL-DREAD]
[JPEG BRAIN: LOSSY COGNITION COLLISION]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Feel that precise dread when a folding chair remembers it used to be a forest!
[ECHO GROUP]: (Used to be a forest! Forest!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Compressed pixels of sorrow taste like copper and wet cardboard!
[SECTION: THERMAL THROTTLING AND FAILURE MODE]
[FAILURE MODE: OVERHEATING — TEMPERATURE RISING WITH DENSITY]
[TALKING DRUM BLAST BEAT, VIOLIN SCREECH, CELLO BOW FRICTION]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: The sequencer is melting! The pattern buffers are boiling over!
[ECHO GROUP]: (Melting! Boiling over! Over!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Reduce event density! Drop the simultaneous voices! Throttle down to zero!
[SECTION: DENSITY DECREASE AND ANCHOR RETURN]
[CONSTRAINT: DENSITY MAY ONLY DECREASE]
[UPRIGHT BASS SOLO — DRY PLUCK — ALL OTHER INSTRUMENTS MUTE]
[CARNIVAL BARKER — SPOKEN QUIETLY]: Only the upright bass remains. Only the wood and the string.
[ECHO GROUP]: (Only the string. String.)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: The carnival tent has folded into a single point on the horizon.
[SECTION: REFORM STRANGER AND FINAL COGNITIVE DRAIN]
[COSMOLOGICAL SCALE: UNIVERSE-SCALE EXPANSION]
[ZAMPOÑA PANPIPES BLOWING AIR-RICH ONSET WITH NO PITCH]
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: Step right up, galaxies! Step right up, expanding voids!
[ECHO GROUP]: (Expanding voids! Voids! Voids!)
[CARNIVAL BARKER]: The show is over, but the ticket is eternal!
[FADE OUT PIRATE RADIO STATIC AND AGOGÔ BELL RING]
caption: An avant-garde theatrical funk performance set in hell's administrative bureaucracy. Guided by a carnival barker and a distorted echo group, the arrangement features a pélog-informed non-equidistant tuning system, talking-drum speech contours, zampoña panpipes, cellular-automaton rhythms, and motion-driven tempo acceleration. Governed by pirate radio transmission artifacts, thermal throttling failure modes, and strict monotonic density reduction under intense conceptual friction.
